messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed onboarding heartbeat metric drop for EU accounts. Gap in CRM webhook delivery around 10:12 UTC, might be causing playbook triggers to misfire.
priya: I saw that too. connector-prod logs show `POST /webhook` 500s from 10:12:05–10:15:30, retries queued.
jamal: we bumped a consumer earlier for the analytics reindex, could have spiked pubsub ack latency. checking backlog now.
leah: Can someone run a quick sample across impacted accounts? `./scripts/heartbeat-check --region eu --since 1h` should show which accounts need backfill.
alex: ran it, quick sample output: ~1.2k accounts with last_activity null or >72h stale. examples: `acct_73f2`, `acct_9b4c`.
priya: Proposed mitigation: 1) pause outbound triggers for the 'eu-heartbeat' rule, 2) enqueue a controlled backfill for stale accounts, 3) notify account owners with counts and ETA.
jamal: +1. I'll scale the consumer down to reduce contention and then start a backfill worker with `--rate 50/s` to avoid hammering connectors.
leah: I'll create an ops ticket and add owners + enable a temporary suppression tag on affected accounts. /cc @priya @alex :thumbsup: 
cs-ops-bot: Incident tracker created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CSOPS-2198 — status: investigating.
alex: Also: hold healthscore recalcs for these accounts until backfill completes, we don't want false renewal-risk alerts.
priya: Agreed — flipping the healthscore-calc gate for cohort `eu-heartbeat` now.
leah: ETA: scaling + pause in ~8m, backfill kickoff ~20m. will post updates and a short summary to owners once queued.
alex: Thanks team. If anyone sees more 500s or connector errors, drop logs here or DM with `request-id` so we can trace.
